{{Top|leg}}
The '''fire bush''' was a low-growing plant native to the jungles of [[Togoria/Legends|Togoria]]. Used by the native [[Togorian/Legends|Togorians]] for starting fires, the resins within in the wood burned with a sputtering, green flame, and produced a smoke that drove off most insects.
